talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
